NEW MODEL — Blauer Board Shop describes it as a "new model" [9] 10. Board art by: Steve Carranza (@carranzaart) [1] 11. Board designs are size specific and cannot be swapped between sizes 12. Designer collaboration: Matt "Mayhem" Biolos — the brain behind Lost Surfboards 13. Biolos and Mervin Manufacturing (Lib Tech) co-founder Pete Saari are longtime friends and had batted the collab idea around for years. And it finally happened in 2015 14. Pro model rider: Matt's all new high performance camber / no mag freestyle twin developed under the feet of Mammoth mountain freestyle ATV ruler, Devin Tubbs 15. A powerhouse snowboarder born and raised in Mammoth Lakes, Devin Tubbs takes any line whether he's riding big mountain terrain, backcountry terrain, or parks 16. Matt's snowboard shaping acumen is heavily influenced by what he's learned while creating his global blockbuster surf shapes. What he learns in surf he immediately starts brainstorming on how to apply that to snow. This surf / snow - shaping / testing feedback loop creates crossover performance characteristics 17. Manufacturer: Mervin Manufacturing [3] 18. Mervin Manufacturing was founded by snowboarders Mike Olson and Pete Saari in 1977 19. Manufacturing location: Based out of Carlsborg, Washington, between the rugged Olympic and Cascade Mountain Ranges 20. In an industry where virtually every other snowboard, ski, skateboard, and surfboard company has moved production to China or offshore, Mervin is the longest running and last major board building factory in the USA 21. Parent company: As of 2013, Mervin was purchased by Altamont Capital Partners 22. Manufacturing process: Mervin Made Hand made at the Mervin Factory in Washington, USA with zero hazardous waste 23. Sustainability - Eco Materials: Eco Materials like Non-petroleum based bio-plastics, soy based elastomer sidewalls, low VOC epoxy, additive free basalt fibers and FSC "pure" certified wood cores 24. Sustainability - Energy: All the electricity used by the factory is "green" power specially contracted from the local PUD 25. Factory heating: The factory's heating system runs on canola-based bio-diesel 26. Forestry certification: FSC "pure" certified wood cores [23] 27. Printing process: Mervin sublimates rather than silkscreens its graphics. Our sublimation process eliminates the need for the super toxic automotive lacquer gloss coats 28.
